name: Fate/Grand Order Lostbelt No. 7: Nahui Mictlān
storyline:
An unexpected encounter with the Foreign God led to an even more unexpected alliance. While the President's motives on the galactic scale remain impossible to determine, their existence alone motivates Chaldea's Master to survive the Lostbelt. Despite the obvious differences, occasional flashes of familiarity prompt Master to wonder about what might have been.

However, the golden sea of trees mercilessly wrenched Master back to reality.

"Think of this as your trial run at extinction. It's bound to happen eventually, so you may as well enjoy it early."

The future of the Seventh Lostbelt presented by Crypter Daybit Sem Void and his Servant... In search of a way to avoid absolute destruction, Master delves into a subterranean world divided into nine layers, toward the land where the buds of emptiness have taken root, and where unprecedented crisis waits, dormant...
summary: The final chapter of Cosmos in the Lostbelt.
